title: Home
headline: Crafted with Intention. Roasted with Precision.
content: Welcome to Aura, where world-class single-origin coffees meet seasonal, locally sourced culinary plates.

seo.metaDescription: Specialty coffee roastery and seasonal kitchen in Portland.

title: Our Story
headline: From Seed to Savor
content: We travel directly to cooperatives in Yirgacheffe, Huila, and Antigua to source micro-lot beans directly from generational farmers. We pay on average 2.4x the Fair Trade minimum to ensure sustainable wages and soil stewardship.

seo.metaDescription: Learn about our farm-direct relationships and roasting craft.

content: Explore our curated pour-overs, espresso drinks, fresh pastries, and signature savory bowls.
